many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c in range(W):
        runs=[]; r=0
        while r<H:
            if not g[r][c]: r+=1; continue
            s=r; v=g[r][c]
            while r<H and g[r][c]==v: r+=1
            runs.append((s,r-1,v))
        runs.sort(key=lambda kv:kv[0])
        prev=-1; n=len(runs)
        for i,(s,e,v) in enumerate(runs):
            start = 0 if i==0 else prev+1
            end = e if i<n-1 else H-1
            for rr in range(start,end+1): out[rr][c]=v
            prev=e
    return out

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c in range(W):
        pos={}
        for r in range(H):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v not in pos: pos[v]=r
        items=sorted(pos.items(), key=lambda kv:kv[1])
        prev=-1; n=len(items)
        for i,(cv,fr) in enumerate(items):
            rows=[r for r,v in list(G.get('Demo pair 1 input',[]))[0]]
            mx=max([rr for rr in range(H) if G['Demo pair 1 input'][rr][c]==cv and rr>=fr])
            st = 0 if i==0 else prev+1
            end = min(mx, items[i+1][1]-1) if i<n-1 else H-1
            for rr in range(st,end+1): out[rr][c]=cv
            prev=end
    return out

import json
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(W):
        nz=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if len(nz)<2: continue
        # paint upward from each dot until the previous nonzero
        for i,(ra,va) in enumerate(nz):
            if i==0: continue
            pr,_=nz[i-1]
            for rr in range(max(pr+1,0),ra):
                o[rr][c]=va
        # topmost dot paints upward to grid top
        r0,v0=nz[0]
        for rr in range(0,r0): o[rr][c]=v0
    return o

    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

    return o

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))
gi=G['Demo pair 1 input']; go=G['Demo pair 1 output']
# classify columns by whether gaps are filled
for c in range(len(gi[0])):
    nz=[(r,int(gi[r][c])) for r in range(len(gi)) if gi[r][c]!=0]
    out=[go[r][c] for r in range(len(gi))]
    # is column "filled"?: every cell between first and last dot is non-zero
    first,last=nz[0][0],nz[-1][0]
    filled=all(out[r]!=0 for r in range(first,last+1))
    print(c, nz, 'filled between edges:', filled, 'num dots:', len(nz))

import json
def f(gi):
    gi=[list(r) for r in gi]; H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for c in range(W):
        nz=[(r,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) if gi[r][c]!=0]
        if not nz: continue
        b=max(r for r,_ in nz)
        if b!=H-1: continue
        top=min(r for r,_ in nz)
        colors={v for _,v in nz}
        # fill above top
        for r in range(top): out[r][c]=nz[0][1]
        # between consecutive
        for i in range(len(nz)-1):
            r0,r1=nz[i][0],nz[i+1][0]
            if r1>r0+1:
                for r in range(r0+1,r1): out[r][c]=nz[i+1][1]
        # below bottom
        for r in range(b+1,H): out[r][c]=nz[-1][1]
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(name, f(G[name+' input'])==G[name+' output'])
res=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(res))
